images.prompt: Side-view 2D platform-fighter arena, game environment concept art, 16:9 widescreen, camera straight-on. Scene: a vertical mountain gorge — one towering peak crowned with twisted pines, a thread of waterfall, bamboo groves, a small stone bridge and a roofed pavilion on a crag as ledges, a village lost in mist below. Palette: black ink in five dilutions, white paper, a little indigo-cyan and ink green, no warm colour. Organic hand-made shapes, irregular silhouettes, nothing tile-like or grid-aligned, no repeated stamps. No text, no lettering, no UI, no watermark, no border. --ar 16:9

Top-down fantasy world map of a single roughly circular island, hand-drawn on aged parchment by one cartographer. The island has an organic, irregular coastline. At its exact centre sits a small pitch-black regular pentagon, a void, with scorched paper edges. Five winding rivers of varying width run from the pentagon's five sides out to the sea, cutting the island into five wedge-shaped realms. Each realm is drawn in a different art medium, yet all share the same paper and the same brown ink coastline: (1) a pink seaside kingdom in loose storybook watercolour with a small cream castle and palm trees; (2) misty peaks, bamboo and pines in black Chinese ink wash with lots of bare paper; (3) a sandy frontier ghost town with mesas in rust-and-ochre linocut print; (4) a tangled dark wood with a pumpkin-lantern castle in blue-and-black scratchboard; (5) stepped pyramids and jade canals in pixel art with thin neon lines. Small city markers (dots, diamonds, stars) joined by dotted roads that never cross a river. Around the coast: ripple-line hatching, a compass rose, a decorative border. No text, no lettering, no labels.
